name: Banana Bread
subtitle: From Grandma Kemper
notes: From Pam—the best I can find.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.body: Mix together **1 cup sugar**, **½ cup butter**, **2 eggs**, **2 cups flour**, **1 tsp baking soda**, **¼ tsp salt** and **1 tsp baking powder**.

steps.title: Add the bananas and nuts
steps.body: Add **5 mashed ripe bananas** and nuts.

steps.title: Pour into the pan
steps.body: Pour into a greased loaf pan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for 1 hour (about 35 minutes for the smaller loaves).

steps.title: Wrap
steps.body: Wrap in foil while still slightly warm.

yields: 1 large loaf (about 12 slices), or 2–3 smaller loaves (estimated)
